section.heading: Establishment of District of Columbia Homeland Security Commission; membership.

annotations.annotation: For temporary (90 days) amendment of this section, see § 508 of the Omnibus Criminal Code Amendment Congressional Review Emergency Act of 2013 (D.C. Act 20-44, April 1, 2013, 60 DCR 5381, 20 DCSTAT 1281).
For temporary amendment of (b)(1), see § 508 of the Omnibus Criminal Code Amendments Emergency Amendment Act of 2012 (D.C. Act 19-599, January 14, 2013, 60 DCR 1017).

The 2013 amendment by D.C. Law 19-320 added “except that initially 4 Commission members shall be appointed to a 3-year term and 3 Commission members shall be appointed to a 2-year term” at the end of (b)(1); and made a related change.
This section is referenced in § 1-523.01 and § 7-2271.01.
For temporary (90 days) amendment of this section, see § 3012 of Fiscal Year 2027 Budget Support Emergency Act of 2026 (D.C. Act 26-416, Aug. 13, 2026, 73 DCR 11509).
